weather.note: Green Bay, noon CT kickoff: Wunderground’s hourly forecast has 44 to 47°F through the game, mainly sunny, 8% chance of rain and light winds.

low_conf.MIN: Kirk Cousins has 0 pass attempts for the Vikings this season, so their numbers are low confidence.

notes: Kyler Murray (hamstring) is out. Kirk Cousins, acquired from the Raiders on Tuesday, is expected to start, but Kevin O’Connell had not formally named him as of the last reports found; Carson Wentz is the alternative. Calls are held until the starter is confirmed.
Packers RB Josh Jacobs (finger) is out on the final report.
